label: Toy 4-entry FIFO with a golden reference model (fixture-authored, synthetic)

clauses.text: The FIFO holds at most 4 entries. A push while it holds 4 is refused (ok is false); a push while it holds fewer is accepted.
A pop while the FIFO is not empty is served and returns the oldest accepted value still held.
A pop while the FIFO is empty is not served and returns no value.
After every operation, count equals the number of entries held.
After every operation, full is true exactly when 4 entries are held and empty is true exactly when none are held.
